ruleDefinitions.name: File Download Via Nscurl - MacOS
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of the nscurl utility in order to download files.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/nscurl$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-download\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-download\\-directory\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-output\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-dir\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-dl\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-ld.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-o\\ .*")))
